name: Domino Effect's Gambit
author: Agent15
summary: When an enemy piece is trapped, trap every enemy piece adjacent to it.
description: Trapping an enemy piece chains outward: every untrapped adjacent black piece gets trapped too, and each of those re-fires the trigger, so a well-placed trap can cascade across a cluster. Hooks both the hunter-tile and piece trap events. Epic rarity, priced at 8. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.
